fields.Name: T169 - Human Review Queue Submission
fields.Description: Exercises the accordion-based review-queue write path (SubmitReview → instrumentation submitFeedback) with reason badges — a distinct human-in-the-loop form, different code from the Runs detail-panel feedback form.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher next to the logo, choose "Testing", then click the "Review" tab. The Human Review view shows a KPI summary and a Review Queue. If pending items exist, expand one accordion item, pick a Rating number, click a correctness button (Correct or Incorrect), optionally type a note, then click Submit and verify the item is accepted (it leaves the queue or shows a submitted state). If the queue is empty, confirming the "All caught up!" empty state renders correctly is also success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Review tab shows a KPI summary row and a Review Queue (with pending accordion items OR an 'All caught up!' empty state)
If items exist: expanding one reveals a rating scale, correctness buttons, and a notes field, and Submit becomes enabled once a rating/correctness is chosen
Submitting removes/updates the item, or the empty-state path renders cleanly
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
